title: Took forever to arrive and contained less than advertised.
text: Arrived literally 4 months after I ordered it. The box looked like it had been through 3 different countries before arriving on my doorstep. The inside of the box was very unprofessional looking with a cheap toy and only 8 pizzle sticks included. I feel like the introductory 15 dollar price tag had something to do with that. I immediately cancelled my subscription and would never consider resubscribing.
label: negative
